subject: Eval kickoff: Acme Corp — scheduling trial & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next step — eval kickoff scheduling

Hi Alex / Priya,

Great to meet you both today — thanks for the productive discovery call. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood for in-product summarization and intelligent search across Acme's customer support docs.
- Success criteria you mentioned: >= 85% accuracy on intent extraction, average response latency < 400ms at 95th percentile, and token-cost within your $0.05/message target.
- Initial scope: 2k daily queries, phased-up over 6 weeks, tight security (VPC + SOC2 evidence), and ability to pin model versions.

Next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff (trial plan + prompt set + success criteria alignment + technical deep dive). Please pick a 60–90 min slot next week that works for your team — we'd like to include a short demo and then a technical deep-dive with our infra/ML lead. Proposed windows (PST):

- Tue 2026-08-25 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-08-26 13:00–14:30
- Thu 2026-08-27 09:00–10:30

If none of those work, share two alternatives and we'll accommodate.

I’ve attached a preliminary evaluation plan (acme-eval-plan-v1.pdf) and a trial steps spreadsheet (redwood-trial-steps.xlsx) — both are rough so we can iterate.

Attaching: acme-eval-plan-v1.pdf (PDF), redwood-trial-steps.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks — looking forward to locking in a time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference runtime
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next step — eval kickoff scheduling

Thanks Marissa — great summary.

Wed 2026-08-26 13:00–14:30 PST works for our team (Priya and I will join). For the technical deep dive, we'll want:

- A short architecture walkthrough covering VPC/private deployment options and key management (KMS/HSM).
- Details on performance tuning (batching/quantization) and expected latency at our target qps.
- A sample prompt set from you that mirrors our top 50 support intents so we can sanity-check evals.

Two quick asks before the kickoff:
1) Can you confirm the security evidence items you can provide during the kickoff (SOC 2, audit logs, data retention docs)?
2) Can you share the draft prompt set and the evaluation metric definitions (how you'll measure the 85% accuracy target)?

We reviewed the attached eval plan at a high level — looks good. If you can confirm the above and share the drafts, we'll prep internal stakeholders.

Alex
Director of AI Engineering, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com | +1 312-555-0987

Subject: Re: Recap & next step — eval kickoff scheduling

Alex — perfect, thanks for confirming. Wed 2026-08-26 13:00–14:30 PST is on our side as well.

Agenda (60–75 min):
- 13:00–13:10 Intro + success criteria alignment (Marissa, Alex)
- 13:10–13:30 Short demo: summarization & semantic search (Marissa)
- 13:30–14:00 Technical deep dive: infra, VPC options, KMS, latency/throughput knobs (Connor + Neha)
- 14:00–14:20 Prompt set review & eval plan (Connor)
- 14:20–14:30 Q&A / next steps (all)

Connor and Neha are looped for the deep-dive and prompt/eval discussion. Connor — can you bring the sample prompt set (top-50 intents) and a short doc describing evaluation metrics (precision/recall thresholds, sampling strategy, measurement infra)? I’ve uploaded the current draft prompt set and eval metric doc to the shared drive link below; feel free to update before the meeting.

Shared docs: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRst

Attachments: acme-eval-plan-v1.pdf, redwood-trial-steps.xlsx

Thanks — see you Wednesday.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa & Alex — we'll be ready Wednesday. Quick notes from the infra side:

- Security evidence: we'll bring the SOC 2 summary, retention and deletion policy notes, and an audit-logs walkthrough. For any deeper requests (pen tests / HSM screenshots) we can follow up with a secure package after the kickoff.
- Prompt set: I'll upload the draft top-50 intents prompt set to the shared doc and attach a short README describing labeling and sampling strategy. Expect that in the shared docs by EOD today.
- Measurement: we'll propose a measurement plan that includes a labeled validation set (n=500), automated scoring for precision/recall, and a weekly regression dashboard. I'll add the metric definitions to the drive.

If there are specific data-security or compliance folks you want in the call, ping me and I'll invite them.

Connor O'Brien
Infra & Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0433
